source.name: New Hampshire General Court bill status data dump
source.note: Pipe-delimited files published by the General Court; parsed by scripts/fetch_nh_bills.py. Column mapping audited in data/raw/_discovery_report.md.

vetoes.title: Every veto and what happened to it
vetoes.why: Veto fights are the clearest record of where the governor and the legislature's majority split.

close_votes.title: Bills decided by a handful of votes
close_votes.why: A close roll call means a small number of legislators decided the outcome; that is a name-the-names story.

parked.title: Bills parked without a final vote
parked.why: Interim study, retention, re-referral, and tabling end bills quietly. Who asked for the parking and why.

effective_soon.title: New laws taking effect in the next few months
effective_soon.why: Readers want to know what changes on the date it changes.

most_roll_calls.title: The most fought-over bills
most_roll_calls.why: Roll-call count is a proxy for how hard each side pushed.

died_in_other_chamber.title: Passed one chamber, died in the other
died_in_other_chamber.why: House-Senate friction inside one party is an under-covered story.

recent_activity.title: What moved in the last 45 days
recent_activity.why: Anything still moving after the session ended is news by definition.

top_prime_sponsors.title: Who filed the most bills
top_prime_sponsors.why: Volume filers and their success rates.

beats.title: Bills by GSR beat
beats.why: Keyword match on titles; a starting list, not a verdict.
